sections.en:
Wet bathroom floors and easy-clean wall tiles

We select the bathroom floor finish using the tile product’s wet-area slip information, the shower layout and the planned falls to the waste. Matt or textured porcelain may be worth comparing, but appearance alone does not confirm grip. Tile size, cuts at the waste, grout joints and cleaning access all affect the installation.

For shower walls, we compare smooth glazed ceramic and porcelain with the intended cleaning routine. A surface that wipes clean easily can still show dried water or soap deposits. We plan the wall joints, mosaic niches and flexible corner seals together; the tiled finish does not replace the waterproofing behind it.

Compare tile materials, finishes and room uses →
sections.zh:
浴室湿态地砖与易清洁墙砖

我们结合产品湿区防滑资料、淋浴布局及通往地漏的排水坡度选择浴室地砖饰面。哑光或纹理瓷质砖可以纳入比较，但不能仅凭外观确认防滑表现。砖的规格、地漏处切割、砖缝及清洁便利性都会影响铺贴安排。

淋浴墙面可结合日常清洁习惯，比较平滑釉面陶瓷墙砖与瓷质墙砖。容易擦洗的表面仍可能出现干水迹或皂垢。我们一起规划墙面砖缝、马赛克壁龛与转角弹性密封；瓷砖饰面不能代替后方防水层。

比较瓷砖材质、表面与使用位置 →

sections.en:
Poolside grip, barefoot comfort and coping profiles

We compare outdoor porcelain products using their wet-area slip-test information and suitability for the proposed poolside use. Barefoot comfort, sun exposure, cleaning and the edge profile matter alongside grip. A rougher surface is not automatically the best choice for every pool edge, and a matt label is not a slip rating.

For coping, we check the thickness and available edge pieces against the terrace tiles, drainage and existing pool edge. Stone-look porcelain and natural travertine are different materials with different care requirements. Share the actual product and coping profile so we can assess the fixing, joints and finished levels together.

Compare tile materials, finishes and room uses →
sections.zh:
泳池周边防滑、赤脚舒适度与压顶边型

我们依据户外瓷质砖的湿区防滑测试资料及拟用泳池周边位置的适用说明比较产品。除抓地表现外，还要考虑赤脚舒适度、日晒、清洁与边缘造型。更粗糙的表面并非适合每一种泳池边沿，哑光名称也不等于防滑等级。

泳池压顶需结合池畔地砖、排水与现有池边，核对厚度和配套边型。仿石瓷质砖与天然洞石属于不同材料，养护要求也不同。请提供实际产品与压顶造型，方便我们一并评估粘贴、接缝和完成面高度。

比较瓷砖材质、表面与使用位置 →

sections.en:
Splashback surfaces for cooking splashes and grout care

For an easy-clean splashback, we compare smooth glazed ceramic or porcelain surfaces with heavily textured tiles and small mosaics. The glaze, surface relief and amount of exposed grout affect how you reach and wipe cooking splashes. Gloss, satin and matt describe appearance; none is a promise that grease or food marks cannot remain.

We discuss cement-based and epoxy grout options using the selected product’s stain-resistance and cleaning information, joint width and compatibility with the tile. Cuts around outlets, exposed edges and the flexible benchtop junction are planned before fixing. The cooktop instructions and project requirements also guide the material choice near appliances.

Compare tile materials, finishes and room uses →
sections.zh:
便于清洁烹饪溅污的防溅墙饰面与填缝

希望防溅墙便于清洁时，我们会将平滑釉面陶瓷砖或瓷质砖，与凹凸纹理砖和小规格马赛克进行比较。釉面、表面起伏与外露填缝面积，会影响擦洗烹饪溅污的便利性。亮面、缎光和哑光描述外观，都不意味着油污或食物痕迹绝不会残留。

我们依据具体产品的耐污与清洁资料、砖缝宽度及与瓷砖的兼容性，沟通水泥基或环氧填缝方案。铺贴前规划插座周边切割、外露边缘及台面弹性接缝。靠近电器处的选材还需结合灶具说明和项目要求。

比较瓷砖材质、表面与使用位置 →

sections.en:
Wall glaze, water spots and stone-look finishes

We compare ceramic wall tiles, porcelain wall tiles and glass mosaics by the actual body, surface and backing. Smooth glazed finishes can simplify wiping; strong relief and extra mosaic joints add detail to the cleaning routine. Dark, glossy and textured samples may show water deposits differently, so compare a sample where it will be used.

Marble-look porcelain is not natural marble, and mosaic describes a format rather than one material. We check tile weight, wall condition, adhesive suitability and exposed edges before agreeing the installation. For natural stone, share the exact stone type and care instructions so fixing and maintenance can be reviewed before the scope is confirmed.

Compare tile materials, finishes and room uses →
sections.zh:
墙砖釉面、水迹与仿石饰面

我们按实际砖体、表面与背面构造，比较陶瓷墙砖、瓷质墙砖和玻璃马赛克。平滑釉面通常便于擦洗；明显凹凸纹理与较多马赛克砖缝，则增加清洁时需要兼顾的细节。深色、亮面和纹理样品呈现水垢的方式可能不同，宜在实际使用位置比较样品。

仿大理石瓷质砖不是天然大理石，马赛克也只是形式，不限定一种材质。我们在商定铺贴前检查砖重、墙面状况、瓷砖胶适用性与外露边缘。如考虑天然石材，请提供具体石种和养护说明，方便在确认范围前核对粘贴与维护要求。

比较瓷砖材质、表面与使用位置 →

sections.en:
Floor tile body, surface finish and cleaning needs

For connected rooms, we compare porcelain and floor-rated ceramic products for the intended traffic, cleaning and wet entrances. Porcelain, polished, glazed and rectified describe different features. A polished surface or marble-look pattern is not a separate material, and a rectified edge still needs a planned grout joint.

We check product thickness, format and the required preparation against door clearances and adjoining finishes. Natural stone, real terrazzo and cement tiles have their own fixing and care requirements; a look-alike porcelain tile should not inherit their material label. Product details help us define the base, adhesive, joints and any specified sealing in the written scope.

Compare tile materials, finishes and room uses →
sections.zh:
地砖砖体、表面处理与清洁需求

相连房间选砖时，我们按通行、清洁及入口受潮情况，比较瓷质砖与明确适用于地面的陶瓷砖。瓷质、抛光、釉面和精修边描述不同特征。抛光表面或仿大理石花色并不是另一种材质，精修边也仍需规划砖缝。

我们结合门口净空与相邻饰面，核对产品厚度、规格和所需基层处理。天然石材、真正水磨石和水泥砖各有相应粘贴与养护要求，仿其外观的瓷质砖不能沿用这些材质名称。提供产品资料，有助于在书面范围中明确基层、瓷砖胶、接缝及产品规定的封护处理。

比较瓷砖材质、表面与使用位置 →

sections.en:
Outdoor porcelain, pavers and exposed surface care

We assess the actual exterior material and specification. Stone-look describes appearance; terracotta may identify fired clay or only a product colour; bluestone is a stone trade name that needs the actual stone type confirmed. Outdoor porcelain, natural stone pavers and fired-clay products have different product instructions. Check that the material and finish suit the actual weather exposure, wet walking surface and cleaning routine.

The tile thickness and intended installation method need to fit the base, falls, doorway levels and step edges. A porcelain paver is not automatically a direct substitute for a bonded tile. Send the supplier specification with the area you want finished so we can assess preparation, edge details and care before confirming the work.

Compare tile materials, finishes and room uses →
sections.zh:
户外瓷质砖、铺装板与外露表面养护

我们评估实际户外材质与规格。仿石描述外观；Terracotta 可能指烧制陶土，也可能只是产品颜色；Bluestone 则是石材商品名称，需确认实际石种。户外瓷质砖、天然石材铺装板和烧制陶土产品的说明不同。应核对材质和表面是否适合实际风雨暴露、湿态行走与日常清洁。

产品厚度与拟定安装方式需适配基层、排水坡度、门口高度和台阶边缘。瓷质铺装板不能自动作为粘贴式瓷砖的直接替代品。请将供应商规格与拟施工区域一并提供，方便我们在确认工作前评估基层处理、边缘节点与养护要求。

比较瓷砖材质、表面与使用位置 →

sections.en:
Choose the material, finish and installation location together

For bathroom floors and pool surrounds, we check wet-use suitability and slip information. For shower walls and splashbacks, we compare glaze, texture, water deposits, cooking splashes and grout care. Tell us the product you are considering and where it will be installed so we can match preparation, fixing and finishing to the job.

Compare tile materials, finishes and room uses →
sections.zh:
结合材质、表面与安装位置选砖

浴室地面和泳池周边需核对湿态使用与防滑资料；淋浴墙面和厨房防溅墙则比较釉面、纹理、水垢、烹饪溅污与填缝养护。请说明拟选产品和安装位置，方便我们为项目匹配基层处理、粘贴与收口。

比较瓷砖材质、表面与使用位置 →

sections.en:
Tile materials, finishes and room uses

Compare tile materials, finishes and room uses →

How do porcelain, ceramic and natural stone differ?

Porcelain is a dense, low-absorption type of ceramic material, although Australian retail ranges commonly list porcelain and ceramic separately. Ceramic ranges include wall and floor products; natural stone is quarried material identified by its stone type. We check the actual product designation and intended use. The finish, weight, thickness and fixing requirements still need review for your surface.

Are matt tiles automatically suitable for bathroom floors and pool surrounds?

No. Matt describes appearance, not verified slip performance. We review the selected product’s wet-use slip information and proposed location, including barefoot comfort at a pool edge. Drainage, grout joints, cleaning and the coping profile also matter. A wall tile or polished finish should not be selected for a wet floor solely because its colour matches.

Which bathroom wall tiles are easier to clean, and can water marks still show?

We compare smooth glazed ceramic and porcelain with the proposed wall use and cleaning routine. A smooth surface can make wiping easier, but dried water and soap deposits may still show. Gloss and satin change the appearance; textured surfaces and mosaic joints change the cleaning detail. Use the tile and grout care instructions, and keep the separate waterproofing scope clear.

Which splashback tiles make cooking splashes easier to clean?

Smooth glazed ceramic or porcelain is worth comparing with deeply textured tiles and small mosaics. Check the actual surface, exposed grout and product cleaning instructions rather than relying on a gloss or matt label. We assess tile layout, cement-based or epoxy grout suitability and the flexible benchtop junction. Materials near the cooktop also need to suit the appliance instructions and project requirements.

Do stone, terrazzo and cement tiles need the same care as porcelain?

Use the actual material’s care instructions. Marble, limestone and travertine can be affected by acidic cleaners, while real terrazzo, cement and terracotta products may have specific sealing requirements. Sealing is not a substitute for a wet-area membrane or a promise against every stain. Stone-look or terrazzo-look porcelain is porcelain with that appearance, not the natural or cement-based material it resembles.

Do mosaic, rectified and stone-look identify the tile material?

No. Mosaic describes a format, rectified describes the edge treatment and stone-look describes appearance. A mosaic may be glass, porcelain, ceramic or stone. Polished, matt, gloss and lappato describe different surface finishes. We record the actual material, size, finish and installation location together so the adhesive, joints, edges and care can be assessed correctly.
sections.zh:
瓷砖材质、表面与使用位置

比较瓷砖材质、表面与使用位置 →

瓷质砖、陶瓷砖与天然石材有什么区别？

瓷质砖属于砖体致密、吸水率较低的陶瓷材料，但澳洲零售产品通常将 Porcelain 与 Ceramic 分列。Ceramic 系列既有墙砖也有地砖；天然石材则是按具体石种区分的开采材料。我们核对实际产品分类和用途，同时评估饰面、重量、厚度与对应表面的粘贴要求。

哑光砖一定适合浴室地面和泳池周边吗？

不一定。哑光描述外观，并不代表经过核实的防滑表现。我们核对具体产品的湿态防滑资料和拟用位置，泳池边沿还要考虑赤脚舒适度。排水、砖缝、清洁与压顶边型也很重要。不能仅因颜色匹配，就将墙砖或抛光饰面用于湿态地面。

哪些浴室墙砖更容易清洁？还会出现水迹吗？

我们结合墙面用途与日常清洁习惯，比较平滑釉面陶瓷砖和瓷质砖。平滑表面通常便于擦洗，但仍可能显现干水迹和皂垢。亮面与缎光改变外观，纹理表面和马赛克砖缝则改变清洁细节。应遵循瓷砖及填缝养护说明，同时明确独立的防水工作范围。

哪些厨房防溅墙砖更方便清洁烹饪溅污？

可将平滑釉面陶瓷砖或瓷质砖，与深纹理砖和小规格马赛克进行比较。应核对实际表面、外露填缝及产品清洁说明，不能仅凭亮面或哑光名称判断。我们评估排砖、水泥基或环氧填缝的适用性，以及台面弹性接缝。灶具附近材料还需符合电器说明与项目要求。

石材、水磨石和水泥砖的养护与瓷质砖相同吗？

应按实际材质的养护说明处理。大理石、石灰石和洞石可能受酸性清洁剂影响，真正水磨石、水泥砖和陶土砖可能有特定封护要求。封护不能代替湿区防水层，也不代表能抵御所有污渍。仿石或仿水磨石瓷质砖仍是相应外观的瓷质砖，并非它所模仿的天然或水泥基材料。

马赛克、精修边与仿石，说明的是瓷砖材质吗？

不是。马赛克描述形式，精修边描述边缘加工，仿石描述外观。马赛克可能采用玻璃、瓷质、陶瓷或石材。抛光、哑光、亮釉面和半抛光则描述不同表面处理。我们将实际材质、规格、表面与安装位置一起记录，以便准确评估瓷砖胶、接缝、边缘与养护。
